segments.en:
Because the rectification of song and melody is through the Oral Torah (Torah SheBeal Peh),
therefore the Sages, z"l, taught in the Tikunim
that Teruah alludes to [the acronym]
T-O-R-A-H [Tav-Vav-Reish-Hay] — see the inner text [of the discourse] —
which is the dimension of the entire Oral Torah.
And therefore the Shofar soundings allude also to King David,
as is brought [in the Kabbalistic works] —
for he is in the dimension of the Oral Torah,
as is explained in Likutay Mohara"n, Siman 12.

This is also the dimension of Malchuyos, Zichronos, and Shofaros:
Malchuyos — the dimension of Malchus;
Zichronos — the dimension of the mental faculties and Daas,
as above in Siman 1;
Shofaros — the dimension of melody, as above.

segments.he: ענין ר"ה יו"כ סוכות וכו' מבואר היטב ע"פ מאמר זה בליקוטי הלכות הלכות שבת הלכה ז' ובהלכות ראש השנה הלכה ז' ע"ש:
segments.en:
And this is what is brought in the Zohar:
that the voice of the Shofar and the Teruah
corresponds to Yaakov —
for Yaakov merited to perfect this [holy] voice in its completeness,
the dimension of "the voice is the voice of Yaakov"
[Gen. 27:22].
He merited to rectify the dimension of the holy birds in their supernal root —
and this is the secret of [Yaakov] marrying the daughters of Lavan,
as is understood in the holy Zohar and in the writings of the Ar"i z"l.
And therefore the count of years of prophecy begins from Yaakov,
as brought in Megila Amukkos, Ofen 228.
